repair_note.root_cause: Graphify's full virtualenv bin directory exposed the unintended graphify-mcp entrypoint on the model PATH.
repair_note.fix: Expose only a lane-private graphify symlink directory; keep the transitive graphify-mcp entrypoint off PATH.
repair_note.shared_runner_protocol_impact: All 39 unoccupied corrected-profile protocols were regenerated because the frozen descriptor binds the shared fixture-runner hash.
repair_note.matrix_portability_fix: Graphify protocol identity now binds its generated host-integrated executable contract rather than a warmup shell identity containing a checkout-specific PATH.
